name: Screen Pointer Target Overlay Helper
summary: Captures desktop screenshot via macOS CLI, calculates x/y target coordinates, draws a labeled arrow using Python Pillow, and presents the image in Preview.
steps: Run macOS screencapture command to output latest screen state to screen-guide/latest.png
Pass x/y percentage coordinates and label text to Python Pillow script
Draw red-orange arrow with white outline and dark text label near tail target
Open resulting image in macOS Preview for user visual confirmation
jarvis_use: Enables Jarvis to visually point out buttons or UI elements directly on screen for the human operator.

name: Zero-Cost Native macOS Voice Feedback
summary: Integrates native macOS say CLI tool into agent execution loop to deliver spoken progress updates without third-party TTS API costs.
steps: Audition installed macOS system voices using say command
Configure agent system prompt to append say execution after completing actions
Execute local spoken updates asynchronously after agent command execution
jarvis_use: Provides zero-cost local audio confirmation when Jarvis completes background operations.

name: Voice Narration Mode Toggle Switch
summary: Implements prompt-level keyword listeners to dynamically enable or suppress spoken system feedback based on user context.
steps: Define prompt listener rules for quiet and narrate trigger keywords
Suppress macOS say command execution when set to quiet mode
Re-enable macOS say command execution when set to narrate mode
jarvis_use: Allows user to quickly silence or enable voice alerts depending on environment.

name: 3D Interactive System Knowledge Graph Visualizer
summary: Renders an interactive 3D knowledge graph UI categorizing agent skills, document stores, and prompt modules.
steps: Serve local web UI hosting a 3D force-directed node graph
Group capabilities into category clusters (Skill Suites, Local Businesses, Claude Code)
Allow interactive navigation and node filtering of stored agent knowledge
jarvis_use: Provides visual inspection and navigation of Jarvis's memory, tools, and business context.

name: Localhost Web Vision Screen Sharing Server
summary: Streams target web browser tabs or full screens into local AI context using a web server on port 4719 and Chrome screen share permissions.
steps: Spin up local web service on http://localhost:4719
Trigger Chrome getDisplayMedia screen share selection dialog
Select target tab or window to stream video context
Feed live screen frame buffer into Claude Code vision context
jarvis_use: Allows Jarvis to continuously watch any selected browser tab for live auditing and assistance.

name: Live Vision Document Audit & Critique
summary: Inspects document layout and content via live vision stream to identify structural flaws, bad formatting, and missing metrics.
steps: Capture raw document layout from active screen share stream
Analyze text sections for impact metrics, formatting consistency, and duty descriptions
Generate actionable critique highlighting formatting and phrasing weaknesses
jarvis_use: Evaluates document quality on screen and provides structured feedback before automatic rewriting.

name: Automated Google Docs Cloud Document Drafting
summary: Generates improved document content and automatically creates a formatted Google Doc directly inside Google Drive.
steps: Formulate rewritten markdown content based on visual critique findings
Invoke Google Docs API or automation script to create a new document in Drive
Apply section headings, work history formatting, and project highlights
jarvis_use: Converts visual review recommendations directly into ready-to-use cloud documents.

name: Telegram Mobile Completion Notification Bridge
summary: Delivers mobile push notifications via Telegram API containing direct links to newly generated background outputs.
steps: Complete document creation or long-running background task
Construct notification payload with direct cloud document URL
Send message via Telegram Bot API to human operator mobile device
jarvis_use: Sends instant alerts to the user's phone when background tasks finish with working document links.

name: Autonomous UI Action Execution Loop
summary: Translates high-level multi-step objectives into low-level sequential mouse clicks, typing events, and scroll commands.
steps: Deconstruct UI goal into atomic coordinates, text inputs, and scroll steps
Dispatch mouse movements and keystrokes using System Events, AppleScript, or clickclick
Verify step completion before advancing to the next UI target
jarvis_use: Powers hands-free execution of complex multi-step web dashboard workflows.

name: UI Control Feed with Emergency Abort Switch
summary: Displays real-time step logging feed ('JARVIS IS DRIVING') alongside an immediate manual override kill switch.
steps: Stream step-by-step action logs to active control panel UI
Listen for user input on red STOP button in UI overlay
Instantly kill synthetic input processes upon click event to return full control to user
jarvis_use: Provides continuous visibility and an immediate hard stop mechanism during computer-use takeovers.

name: macOS System Permissions Provisioning
summary: Configures essential Privacy & Security entitlements on macOS to grant screen capturing and synthetic input permissions to Terminal.
steps: Open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Screen Recording
Enable entitlement toggle for active Terminal or Claude Code app
Open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Accessibility
Enable entitlement toggle for active Terminal app to allow mouse/keyboard simulation
jarvis_use: Initial machine configuration step required before Jarvis computer-use scripts can function.

name: Missing Permission Recovery Routine
summary: Detects permission denials (black screenshots or failed click events) and prompts guided instructions to fix OS entitlements.
steps: Detect blank capture outputs or failed click events during execution
Identify missing macOS Screen Recording or Accessibility entitlement
Output step-by-step resolution instructions directing user to System Settings UI
jarvis_use: Prevents silent failures by diagnosing missing OS permissions and guiding the user to fix them.
